official_title: Clonal Fetal Mesenchymal Stem Cell (cfMSC) Therapy for Type II Diabetes Mellitus

arm_groups.label: Clonal fetal mesenchymal stem cells (cfMSCs) therapy for type II diabetes mellitus

primary_outcomes.measure: Number of patients with adverse events.

brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the feasibility, safety and clinical efficacy of the novel clonal fetal mesenchymal stem cell (cfMSC) therapy in patients with type II diabetes mellitus.
